decision: Match A = spray clip v_1323_20 @ 98.867 s (select spray.mp4 frame 446, 3:4 frame cropped x0..1116 -> 1080x1920), scan = Lola 1 Exterior; camera = 7-landmark PnP (f free ~1100 px) -> silhouette refine (GrabCut chamfer + 0.3 landmark weight): fx 1094 px

decision: Ray-Ban Meta video intrinsics: fx 1094 px on the 1080-wide 9:16 crop = ~1130 px on the 1488-wide source, HFOV ~67 deg, no visible distortion

decision: Match B = scanner clip v_1325_50 @ 93.4 s (select scanner.mp4 frame 282, crop x192..1344 of 1536 -> 1080x1920), Lola 1 Exterior; 6-point PnP (fuel door corners, door handle, rear hub, taillight corner) RMSE 5.2 px, free focal 1076 px vs fixed 1094 px identical pose -> used fixed 1094

decision: Scan shots: s1_A Lola 1 ext from cam_A orbit 25 deg; s2_B from cam_B - exterior shell lifts 1.45 m and spins 360 over the bare interior/cage scan while the camera pulls back; s3 Lola 2 hero front-3/4 orbit 30; s4 Lola 2 rear wing orbit; s5 Lola 2 pop-up/front bumper push-in
why: Brief: 1:1 cut then let the matched shot keep going (240SX lesson); Lola 1 Interior + Exterior are the only part split, so exploding the shell off the interior is the 'parts' beat; Lola 2 (the Drifter hero car with the wing) gets the dense-detail close-ups. 9:16 framings checked at 30 %

decision: Lola 2 close-ups rendered from the 4 mm mesh (5.4M tris), not 2 mm
why: 2 mm of a 50M-tri scan would be ~20M tris and risk Blender OOM on 15 GB; the 30 % framing tests show panel lines/lamps reading cleanly at 4 mm

decision: No third 1:1 cut on Lola 2: v_1522_09 17.5 s (rear, wing) used as a plain IRL beat into the colour-model screen recording
why: Tried: camera ~0.5 m behind the bumper, ~2 m high, pitched ~50 deg down; six manual guesses never brought the roof/wing into register and the car fills the frame (no silhouette to refine). Brief only requires the two Lola 1 matches, which are solved and onion-checked

decision: Music = parent-supplied original track (lola-scan-process_track.mp3, 40.0 s). Measured: swell 0-2.25 s, first hit 2.426 (the requested drop), sparse groove to 9.0, full beat from 9.0-9.35 (hi-hat density x3), last big hit 29.82, fade to ~31.3, silent from ~34.8. Strong 40-120 Hz kicks every 1.144 s (= every other beat of 105 BPM, the prompted tempo), loose: LSQ residual up to +-50 ms
why: Kick-peak lesson (FG2): cut on the measured kicks, not the onset detector's 70 BPM grid; the track wanders off a rigid grid so each cut uses the nearest measured kick
